summary.name: AI Image
summary.one_liner: AIImage.com is a browser-based studio that generates and edits images from text prompts and reference photos, letting users run several top image models from one workspace.
use_cases: Generate pitch deck covers and product shots
Create a consistent set of launch hero images
Batch social media posts in multiple sizes
Fill gaps in brand assets like banners
Compare one prompt across several image models
summary.what_it_does: The site offers an online workspace where a user writes a text prompt or drops in a reference photo, picks a model, aspect ratio, resolution and output format, and generates an image. Results are saved to a My Creations library where they can be downloaded, refined, or re-run with a different model. The page says it puts models such as Nano Banana, GPT Image 2, Midjourney and Flux side by side, with the same interface regardless of engine. It also lists many smaller tools such as background remover, image compressor, resizer, cropper and GIF maker. All features are described as running in the cloud in the browser.
notable: Multiple top image models (Nano Banana, GPT Image 2, Midjourney, Flux) in one workspace
Reference-photo input to keep subject, lighting and mood consistent
Library of many small image utilities (background remover, resizer, compressor, GIF maker)
Exports in PNG or JPG at the chosen aspect ratio
caveats: Free tier downloads may carry a watermark; paid plans remove it
Uses a credit system; credits are consumed per completed job
Commercial license and full-resolution export are described for paid plans only
